masterTaxonomy.name: IOC World Bird List
masterTaxonomy.notes: Use IOC as MetaAves master taxonomy and English-name authority. IOC v15.2 lists 11,227 bird species including 164 extinct, in 44 orders, 251 families and 2,389 genera.

enrichment.name: Wikipedia
enrichment.notes: Use Wikipedia for introductory descriptions and lead images only. Structured fields such as diet, breeding and conservation should be separately verified.

thaiNames.notes: Thai common names are enrichment data and are not accepted by the guessing input.
